limitations: A typed value footprint is not a symbol/allocation extent. No complete original allocation identity is claimed.
Location and trait roles use observed register transport plus ABI-equivalent normalized candidate callees and pinned Rust source; original source names/types remain inferred.
Function-pointer comparison proves local normalized body counterparts only, not transitive callee/data identity.
All reads use exact field/string lengths; the frontier64-byte previews are not used as object extents.
